anomalies.detail: Whitespace, form-feed characters, zero-width characters, and obvious mixed-script confusables were normalized during ingestion.
Question 22 included stray source text `the A crime`; canonical content was normalized to `the crime` without changing the underlined markers.
Question 23 included stray source text `by A copyright laws`; canonical content was normalized to `by copyright laws`.
Question 40 mislabeled `built up` as marker D in the source extraction and duplicated marker D on `distance`; canonical content was corrected so `built up` is marker B.
Out-of-range referenced_lines were corrected for P04-RC-01-Q10 and P04-RC-03-Q08 to match the canonical line maps.

note: Anomalies record source problems or deliberate normalization decisions. Canonical files should stay close to the DOCX while avoiding silent guessing.
